sections.title: Enzyme Structure and Catalysis
sections.description: This course will outline the physical chemical basis for enzyme catalysis. The kinetics and thermodynamics of substrate and inhibitor interactions will be discussed prior to an examination of paradigm systems. Topics will include enzymes involved in the regulation of various cellular functions, including proteases, enzymes of natural products biosynthesis, and enzymes of epigenetics.
